decisions.reason: The fifteen-day express program is cheap to maintain, fits the firm's service and fast-response promise, and has stayed visible on the website for two years, so management will defend it as part of its announced direction.

The seventy-two-hour express program is operationally demanding, but the firm has publicly committed to fast delivery and would attribute any weak uptake to a temporary market slowdown rather than abandon it.
The express delivery program for doors and gates has had a dedicated page since launch, a visible commitment central to the firm's quick-response positioning, so persistence is likely.

The online ordering and digital services platform carries sunk IT and integration costs, has its own page, and supports the announced move toward deeper advisory and service support, so management will keep investing in it even if results lag.

The fire and smoke protection door was raised from a mention to a page of its own in 2024, and it likely absorbed certification investment after Product C was withdrawn, which signals strengthened commitment to it as the firm's fire-protection offer.
